title: Gradius
blurb: Horizontal shooter. Stage 1 plays and is audible: the Vic Viper, the Options, the terrain, the enemies and their bullets, the weapons, the power-up meter and the $ED02 sound driver, verified frame-exact against the cartridge.

display.frameHzNote: NES NTSC with rendering ENABLED: PPU 5369318.18 Hz / 89341.5 (frames alternate 89342/89341 -- one cycle is skipped on the pre-render line of odd frames). Blanked, it is 60.098478. Derived, not rounded -- see docs/knowledge/07.

code.entryNote: `entry` STAYS NULL ON PURPOSE. The repo launcher's play stage is Batman-shaped -- its key hints name walking and jumping, and it opens no AudioContext -- so driving Gradius through it would cost the player the sound the W8/W13 audio path exists to produce. `page` is Gradius's OWN start screen (start.html), which is the parity item: mods, presets, level select and the starting power-up picker, all read out of `mods` below. One catalogue, two possible front ends; the day the launcher grows an audio channel and per-game key hints, set `entry` to src/main.js and it works unchanged.

input.note: The $0007 (held) / $0005 (edge) bit layout, MEASURED by A/B RAM diff -- see tools/oracle/PROBE.md 4 and BTN in src/state.js, which this must equal (tests/input.test.js asserts it). The low nibble is direction: `AND #$0F` at $A082 is the ROM's own test for 'any direction held'.

touchLayout.note: The on-screen pad in index.html. The d-pad is ONE pointer-capture surface hit-tested as a 3x3 grid, not four buttons: the corner cells report TWO bits, because updatePlayer() tests X and Y independently and a diagonal is nothing but two bits at once. The cluster is SELECT+START stacked ABOVE B+A -- inline with A/B the row is wider than the space beside the d-pad and A falls off a narrow phone (learned on the Game Boy port).

entries.label: Title screen
entries.note: The cartridge's own boot: mode 0, $8067's state, the 127-frame title scroll-in, the menu countdown and the attract demo (W39). Any stage below skips straight to that stage's $9B3E intro.

entries.label: 1 -- Volcano
entries.note: Volcano / Big Core. The stage every measured scenario lives in; 47 oracle scenarios, 29,693 frames, 0 divergent.

entries.label: 3 -- Moai
entries.note: Moai. Ported W30 -- entry 22, $C906, and the only enemy whose identity is a nametable address.

entries.label: 5 -- Tentacles
entries.note: Tentacles / the $0600 arm pool. Ported W32a-c; the only stage with no terrain collision at all ($C2AB CMP #$04 / RTS).

entries.label: 7 -- Fortress
entries.note: Fortress + the boss rush. Ported W36; the ending and the loop back to stage 1 are W38.

options.label: Weapon
options.note: $44. 0 normal / 1 LASER / 2 DOUBLE -- $89CF stores 1 and $89BB stores 2, measured, not the other way round.

options.label: Options
options.note: $45. Capped at 2 by $89D5 and by this list: $A108 walks OBJECT SLOTS 0..$45 and slots 3-5 are the SHOT slots, so a third Option fires the weapon out of a shot slot.

options.label: Missile
options.note: $41. $A15C gates the missile on it; there is no timer, only the flight time of the one live missile per object.

options.label: Shield
options.note: $46, the remaining hits. $8997 grants 5; $C1C1/$C247/$C293 spend one each. It does NOT stop terrain -- $C2A5 never reads it.

options.label: Speed
options.note: $40. $A006's min(($40+2) AND $FF, $10) is the real saturation; $89A1 has no cap at all, and $40 = 254 wraps and makes the ship STOP.

options.label: Power meter
options.note: $42, the bar cursor. 0 nothing selected, 1..6 a cell; 6 is ?/SHIELD. $894B wraps 7 back to 1, never to 0.
